tool: Spotify Basic Pitch 0.4.0 / bundled ICASSP 2022 ONNX CPU
limitations: Inferred mixed-polyphonic notes, not original score or separated instrument parts.
MIDI 120 BPM is a transport grid, not a measured musical tempo; note timing is absolute seconds.
Detector amplitudes are uncalibrated activation values, not probabilities.
Chord/key/interval flags can be caused by overtones, reverb and transcription errors; not automatic bad-music scores.
No human listening validation has been completed.

results.validationMeaning: Aggregate pitch-class overlap only; not exact-note/voice correctness. Harmonic overtones can inflate agreement.
